title: Unveiling Language Routing Isolation in Multilingual MoE Models for Interpretable Subnetwork Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2604.03592v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models exhibit striking performance disparities across languages, yet the internal mechanisms driving these gaps remain poorly understood. In this work, we conduct a systematic analysis of expert routing patterns in MoE models, revealing a phenomenon we term Language Routing Isolation, in which high- and low-resource languages tend to activate largely disjoint expert sets. Through layer-stratified analysis, we further show that routing patterns exhibit a layer-wise convergence-divergence pattern across model depth. Building on these findings, we propose RISE (Routing Isolation-guided Subnetwork Enhancement), a framework that exploits routing isolation to identify and adapt language-specific expert subnetworks. RISE applies a tripartite selection strategy, using specificity scores to identify language-specific experts in shallow and deep layers and overlap scores to select universal experts in middle lay

translated_title: 揭示多语言MoE模型中的语言路由隔离现象以实现可解释的子网络适配
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型在不同语言之间表现出显著的性能差异，然而驱动这些差距的内部机制仍然知之甚少。在本工作中，我们对MoE模型中的专家路由模式进行了系统性分析，揭示了一种我们称之为“语言路由隔离”的现象，即高资源语言和低资源语言倾向于激活几乎互不相交的专家集合。通过分层分析，我们进一步发现路由模式在模型深度上呈现出逐层收敛-发散的规律。基于这些发现，我们提出了RISE（路由隔离引导的子网络增强），一个利用路由隔离来识别并适配语言特定专家子网络的框架。RISE采用三方选择策略，利用特异性分数识别浅层和深层中的语言特定专家，并利用重叠分数选择中间层的通用专家。
tldr: 该论文揭示了多语言MoE模型中高资源与低资源语言激活几乎不相交专家集合的“语言路由隔离”现象，并提出RISE框架，通过识别和增强语言特定的专家子网络来提升低资源语言的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper uncovers a "Language Routing Isolation" phenomenon in multilingual MoE models, where high- and low-resource languages activate largely disjoint expert sets, and proposes RISE, a framework that identifies and enhances language-specific expert subnetworks to improve performance on low-resource languages.
